note: Footage library for render2.py. Clips are cut from George's own app screen recording and his promo video, only in ranges with no third-party content (a TV showing a show was avoided/blurred) and no burnt-in promo text. All 1080x1920.

ar_portals.shows: AR mode in a room: golden oval Reflection portals, golden rings on the floor with the user's avatar, app UI (record button, MAP, profile)

ar_voicecard.shows: AR mode with an echo playback card: orange waveform, play button, 'Private' visibility tag; top area frosted (blurred)

ar_reflection.shows: AR mode by a window at night: big golden oval Reflection portal, orange spheres floating, rings on floor; 'TAP TO FILM A REFLECTION' near the end. Start from >= 0.9 (first second is a blurry pan)

promo_hands.shows: Hands holding a phone with the echoes map and orange pins, night city (promo video)

promo_aerial.shows: Aerial night city covered in glowing orange echo pins (promo video)

end_card.shows: Brand end card: 'Echoes' logo, YOUR WORLD. YOUR STORIES., DOWNLOAD ECHOES, App Store + Google Play badges. Always the last 2.5s.

stills.map_2d: 2D dark map with golden echo markers clustered around the user's avatar
stills.map_3d: 3D dark map of lower Manhattan with orange labels, TAP TO ECHO and the orange record button
stills.portal_waterfront: Person on a rainy night waterfront raising a phone to a glowing golden portal showing a sunset memory, beam to a ring on the ground (827x1470, upscaled on render)
stills.portal_promenade: Golden portal over a wet promenade at night showing the same place by day, beam to a ring (686x1220, upscaled on render)

style: Dark navy + amber/orange + cream. Text: Inter Display Bold, cream lines, last line amber, top scrim. Hook on screen from frame 0.
